title: Alhamdulillah!
description:
I have been involved in the establishment of Birendranagar Al-Arafa Ibtidai Hafizia Madrasa from the very beginning. With trust in Allah and a sincere intention to promote Islamic education, I started the activities of this madrasa. Alhamdulillah, the institution currently provides educational programs from the Hifz section through the fifth grade of Ibtidai education. The madrasa's activities are continuing, and students from different areas are coming here to receive Islamic and primary education.

Taking this institution forward and continuing its educational activities has been a sincere and ongoing effort of mine. I pray that Allah accepts this religious institution and grants us the ability to make its activities more meaningful and beneficial.

I believe that establishing and supporting a religious and educational institution is not the responsibility of one person alone; rather, it is a valuable opportunity for all of us. Those who wish to support people and contribute to a good religious cause are warmly invited to take part in the educational and charitable activities of this institution according to their means. Your support may help make education easier for a student, strengthen opportunities for Islamic learning, and contribute to keeping this beneficial work continuing for years to come.

Let us come together to support this religious institution and contribute, according to our ability, through charity and Sadaqah. May Allah accept our efforts, however small they may be, grant us goodness and reward in this world and the Hereafter, and give this institution the ability to continue serving Islamic education and the community for many years to come.

I sincerely request everyone to keep me and this madrasa in your prayers. May Allah grant me the strength and ability to continue the activities of this institution and allow me to carry out my responsibilities in the service of Deen with sincerity, dedication, and humility.

Your prayers, support, and sincere cooperation are deeply valued and greatly appreciated.
